languageRequirements.minimum: HSK and HSKK certificates are requested; no minimum score or explicit waiver is published. Zero-level classes are offered, but this does not establish a certificate waiver.

overview.en: A non-degree Chinese-language study route for spring 2027, with small classes by Chinese entry proficiency, from zero-level through advanced.
overview.zh: 2027年春季非学历汉语进修路线，按入学汉语水平安排零起点、初、中、高级小班。

languagePolicy.en: HSK and HSKK certificates requested; no numerical threshold stated. Course levels include zero-level through advanced. The instruction medium itself is not explicitly stated in the two official language brochures; candidate remains held.
languagePolicy.zh: 申请材料列HSK和HSKK证明但未公布最低分；课程含零起点至高级。两份语言简章未明确教学媒介，因此提案保持held。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen, in sound physical and mental health, friendly to China, aged 18–50.
eligibility.zh: 非中国籍公民，身心健康，对华友好，年龄18–50岁。

eligibility.en: Pass comprehensive university review and any scheduled interview or written assessment; watch for notices sent by email.
eligibility.zh: 通过学校综合评审及可能安排的面试或笔试，按邮件通知参加。

applicationMaterials.zh: 重庆师范大学留学生入学申请表。

applicationMaterials.en: Passport copy; applicants with prior travel to China must also submit Chinese visa pages.
applicationMaterials.zh: 护照复印件；如有来华经历，须提交来华签证页。

applicationMaterials.en: Notarized highest diploma. The English page also accepts proof of current study. Other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations under the Chinese page; confirm whether proof of study suffices for the selected route.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经公证的最高学历证明；英文页还列可交在读证明。中英文以外文本须附经公证的中文或英文译文；在读证明是否适用于本路线须向校方确认。

applicationMaterials.en: Notarized academic transcripts; documents not in Chinese or English require notarized Chinese or English translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 经公证的成绩单；中英文以外文本须附经公证的中文或英文译文。

applicationMaterials.en: Study plan in Chinese or English, at least 1,000 words/characters as written in the English page; the Chinese page states at least 1,000 characters.
applicationMaterials.zh: 中文或英文个人学习计划，不少于1000字；英文页原文为 no less than 1000 words/characters。

applicationMaterials.en: HSK and HSKK certificates are requested. Neither page publishes a minimum score or an express waiver, even though the course description includes zero-level classes. Do not assume certificates are optional.
applicationMaterials.zh: 须提交HSK和HSKK成绩证明。两页均未公布最低分数或明确豁免条件；虽然课程含零起点班，不能据此认定成绩证明可不交。

applicationMaterials.en: Two recommendation letters; this language-programme guide gives no recommender-rank requirement.
applicationMaterials.zh: 两封推荐信；本语言项目简章未规定推荐人的职称。

applicationMaterials.en: Foreigner Physical Examination Form and original test reports. The Chinese page requires a public hospital stamp and original laboratory reports for HIV, syphilis and other sexually transmitted diseases, hepatitis B and other listed items. The English page requires all form items, physician signature, hospital stamp and a sealed photograph. Valid for six months.
applicationMaterials.zh: 外国人体格检查记录及原始化验单；须盖公立医院公章，附艾滋病、梅毒等性传播疾病、乙型肝炎等项目原始化验单。英文页还要求涵盖全部表格项目、医生签名、医院公章及骑缝照片；有效期6个月。

applicationMaterials.en: Non-criminal-record certificate. The English guide says it is issued by the local public-security authority and usually within six months before application submission.
applicationMaterials.zh: 无犯罪记录证明；英文页注明由当地公安等机构出具，通常为提交申请前6个月内签发。

applicationMaterials.en: Bank deposit certificate showing at least CNY25,000 or its equivalent in local currency. The English page qualifies this amount as in principle, while the Chinese page gives the minimum without that qualifier.
applicationMaterials.zh: 银行存款证明，金额不少于人民币25000元或等值当地货币；英文页对门槛加有 in principle，中文页未加该限定。

applicationMaterials.en: If applying for a scholarship, submit the corresponding scholarship application form. Scholarship requirements may differ and are subject to the annual scholarship-specific guide.
applicationMaterials.zh: 申请奖学金者须提交相应奖学金申请表；不同奖学金要求以每年专项简章为准。

applicationMaterials.en: Personal works: the English guide limits this to Arts or Design applicants, such as videos or copies of paintings, while the Chinese language guide lists it without a qualifier. Confirm applicability; do not silently omit this discrepancy.
applicationMaterials.zh: 个人作品：英文页限定艺术或设计申请人提交视频、绘画复制件等，中文语言简章未写条件；应向校方确认是否适用，保留两版本差异。

applicationMaterials.en: All notarized and other submitted documents must be in Chinese or English or accompanied by the required translations.
applicationMaterials.zh: 所有公证材料或其他材料须为中文、英文或附相应译文。

notes.en: Fresh complete source review corrects the old stored December 30/31 deadline to December 25, 2026, and removes the unsupported optional-HSK wording and guessed 4–5 month range. The 2026-titled English guide explicitly accepts spring applications September 1–December 25, 2026, hence spring 2027; no annual rollover is invented. Original duration evidence is retained: ZH prose and both catalogue tables March–July, but EN application prose March–June. Submit at least two months before enrollment and confirm exact registration dates from the admission notice. Official brochures publish an HTTP application URL; the same exact host has now been independently fetched over verified HTTPS and displays the university student application system. Teaching medium remains unproven; this candidate is HELD and cannot be approved merely because the subject is Chinese. CNY7000 is per semester; CNY14000/year is a separate option. CNY400 application fee is non-refundable regardless of admission. Double-room housing CNY5400 per academic year per person, electricity/water actual; comprehensive insurance mandatory CNY800/year. EN separately describes X1/X2 charges as CNY400/CNY168 and local health-check/photo estimates CNY400/CNY30; ZH fee table lists visa fee CNY400/year. These are guide quotations, not guaranteed current consular charges. Admission involves comprehensive review and possible interview/written assessment notified by email. Successful applicants receive electronic admission/JW201/JW202/DQ as applicable; apply for X1/X2 at the Chinese embassy/consulate. Register as specified in the admission notice with original graduation proof, passport, notice, visa-study form, original physical record and six two-inch bareheaded photographs, and pay tuition/housing. The English guide says failure to obtain the required certificate cancels admission.
notes.zh: 完整复核将旧12月30/31日截止改为2026年12月25日，删除无依据的“HSK可选”和估计4–5个月时长。英文2026标题简章明确2026年9月1日至12月25日申请春季入学，据此为2027春季，并非擅自顺延。保留原文学时矛盾：中文正文及中英目录均3月–7月，英文申请段为3月–6月；入学前至少两个月申请，准确报到日看录取通知书。简章列HTTP申请地址，现已对同一主机经正常验证HTTPS抓取，确认为校方留学生系统。教学媒介仍缺明确证据，本提案必须held，不能仅据汉语课程名认定。学费7000元/学期，14000元/学年另列；400元报名费无论录取与否均不退。双人间住宿每人每学年5400元，水电据实；必须购买综合医疗保险800元/年。英文另列X1/X2费400/168元、当地体检/照片估计400/30元；中文表签证费400元/年，仅保留简章报价，非当前领馆收费承诺。学校综合评审并可能面试/笔试，邮件通知；录取后依实际情况发录取通知书及JW201/JW202/DQ，通过使领馆办理X1/X2，按通知报到、交学费住宿并带毕业证原件、护照、录取通知书、签证学习表、体检原件及免冠两寸照片6张。英文规定未取得相应证书者取消录取。
